body: New repo GTA7: full scoping doc (docs/NORTHSTAR.md) mapping TRAPX's doctrine (Field Offices, Watchers, Enforcement, K9, Media, Party Stores, factions, receipts) onto real Paper plugin systems on top of the already-live EINHORN_SURVIVAL server, instead of GoblinFoxDragon's own not-yet-built voxel/RPG engine. VS0-VS4 milestone plan. Loadable plugin skeleton (industrial.einhorn.gta7.GTA7Plugin) built, deployed, and confirmed live in server.log before committing. Founder: 'OK I WANT TO PLAY GTA7 OF MINECRAFT - use the trapx docs and the plugin language.'
title: GTA7 — TRAPX doctrine scoped onto real Paper/Minecraft
